name: add3
description: Elementwise three-input addition with signature add3(a, b, c) -> torch.Tensor. The inputs are expected to be contiguous tensors with identical shape and numel. The kernel linearizes the buffers and computes out = bf16(bf16(a + b) + c): each of the two additions is performed in float32 and rounded to bfloat16 exactly once, matching the Torch reference (a + b) + c rather than a single fused float32 accumulation. It returns a newly allocated tensor with the shape and dtype of a; inputs are read-only. An empty-numel input returns an empty tensor without launching. The implementation does not inspect strides, so non-contiguous inputs are outside the exercised layout. The current correctness and benchmark suites exercise contiguous 2-D bfloat16 inputs of shape [num_tokens, hidden].
